title: N63KA Perspective Approach Guides
basis: Cirrus SR22 POH 13772-002 Reissue A (Sections 2 and 4); Perspective system software 0764.38; GFC 700 with GMC 705 mode controller. GFC 700 AFM Supplement 13772-135 and the Cockpit Reference Guide 190-00821 are not on file: verify button names and annunciations against them.

cards.title: ILS
cards.subtitle: Localizer + glideslope | DA
cards.keyTrap: The ILS must be flown on LOC1, never on GPS (POH 2-19 item 4b). Capture the glideslope from below.

steps.action: Get the weather and choose the approach. Check NOTAMs for the approach and navaid.
Load the approach: press PROC, choose 'Select Approach', pick the airport and approach, then the transition (or VECTORS), and press ENT. Choose LOAD now; ACTIVATE when cleared or on vectors.
steps.verify: Approach name and transition in the flight plan match the chart. Database must be current (POH 2-19 item 4).
steps.source: POH 2-19 (approaches must come from the current database)

steps.action: Brief the chart: final course, FAF and its altitude, minimums, missed approach point, missed approach procedure and altitude.
Set minimums: TMR/REF softkey, then Minimums: BARO, enter the DA, then CLR to close.
steps.verify: Minimums bug shows on the altimeter.

steps.action: Make the ILS frequency ACTIVE in NAV1. Loading the approach usually tunes it; if not, tune it with the NAV knob and press the NAV swap key.
steps.when: Before the IAF or vectors to final
steps.verify: Correct frequency in NAV1 ACTIVE (left/top position).

steps.action: Identify the station: select NAV1 on the audio panel and listen to the Morse code.
steps.verify: Morse matches the chart identifier.

steps.action: Course: the system sets the final course when the CDI switches to LOC1; check it matches the chart.
Full approach (via an IAF): fly the transition with the autopilot in NAV on GPS. Use ALT to hold, VS or FLC to descend; set the ALT SEL knob to each cleared altitude first.
steps.verify: FMA: GPS (green) lateral.

steps.action: Vectors: when ATC gives vectors to final, press PROC, 'Activate Vector-to-Final', ENT. Fly ATC headings in HDG mode and hold altitude in ALT.
steps.verify: FMA: HDG and ALT (green).

steps.action: Full approach: follow the magenta CDI through the transition; descend to each charted altitude.
Vectors: PROC, 'Activate Vector-to-Final', ENT; fly ATC headings on the heading bug. Turn on the flight director (FD) for command bars if you want them.
Slow down and configure: Fuel pump BOOST, mixture as required. Normal approach speeds: flaps UP 90-95 KIAS, flaps 50% 85-90 KIAS, flaps 100% 80-85 KIAS.
Check the CDI: with the ILS loaded and active, it switches from GPS to LOC1 automatically as you turn inbound on the final course. If it has not, press the CDI softkey until LOC1.
steps.verify: HSI shows LOC1 in green; course pointer on the final course.
steps.source: POH 2-19 item 4c (VOR/ILS data must be displayed)

steps.action: Cleared for the approach and on an intercept heading (30 degrees or less): press APR.
steps.verify: FMA: LOC armed (white) and GS armed (white); HDG and ALT active (green).

steps.action: LOC captures: lateral becomes LOC (green). Keep ALT until the glideslope.
steps.verify: FMA: LOC (green), GS (white).

steps.action: Turn on the FD and press APR for command bars, or fly raw data: center the green CDI and wait for the glideslope diamond.
Glideslope captures from below at the glideslope intercept altitude: the autopilot starts down. Reduce power to hold your approach speed.
steps.verify: FMA: LOC and GS (green).

steps.action: Set the ALT SEL knob to the missed approach altitude (the autopilot will not level at it while on the glideslope).
At the glideslope: reduce power to start down; keep the CDI and glideslope centered.
Set the ALT SEL knob to the missed approach altitude.
Cross-check altitude at the FAF / outer marker with the chart.
steps.verify: Altimeter matches the chart crossing altitude.

steps.action: Disconnect the autopilot no lower than the minimum use height in the GFC 700 AFM supplement, then hand-fly.
Continue only with the required visual references (14 CFR 91.175); otherwise go around immediately.
steps.verify: Altimeter at the minimums bug.

steps.action: Landing: flaps 100%, 80-85 KIAS.
Autopilot DISENGAGE, power lever FULL FORWARD, flaps 50%, 75-80 KIAS until clear of obstacles; then flaps UP and accelerate.
Press the GO AROUND button on the power lever: the flight director shows go-around pitch and the missed approach sequences in the flight plan.
steps.verify: FMA: GA (green). Flight plan sequences to the missed approach (no SUSP).

steps.action: If SUSP shows at the MAP instead, press the SUSP softkey (or PROC, 'Activate Missed Approach', ENT). If the CDI is still on LOC1 and the missed approach is flown on GPS, press the CDI softkey until GPS.
Once climbing with a rate that meets the procedure's altitudes: set ALT SEL to the missed approach altitude, press AP, then NAV (GPS) or HDG, and FLC or VS for the climb.
steps.verify: FMA: GPS or HDG lateral, FLC/VS with ALTS armed (white).
steps.source: POH 2-20 item g (coupled missed approach allowed with GFC 700 software 0764.09 or later; N63KA has 0764.38)

steps.action: Hand-fly the missed approach on the CDI; FD bars give guidance if FD is on. Set ALT SEL to the missed approach altitude.
Tell ATC 'missed approach' and follow the published missed or ATC instructions.

notes: Minima are DA. The glideslope is approved vertical guidance.

brief.note: Large FMS knob moves the cursor, small knob changes the choice. Pick ACTIVATE instead of LOAD if already cleared.
Minimums bug appears on the altimeter.
Push the small NAV knob to move the cyan tuning box between NAV1 and NAV2. Loading the approach often pre-tunes it.
Fly ATC headings: HDG knob, then HDG on the autopilot.
Push ALT SEL to sync to current altitude.

keyReference.group: Flight plan and procedures (PFD bezel or FMS keyboard)

items.does: Procedures menu: Select Approach, Activate Approach, Activate Vector-to-Final, Activate Missed Approach
Large = move cursor between fields, small = change the value; push = show/hide cursor
Accept the highlighted choice
Cancel / back out; hold on the MFD for the default map
Flight plan page: check the loaded approach legs and fixes
Direct to a fix (e.g. the IAF or FAF when ATC clears you)
Navigation source: GPS → VOR1/LOC1 → VOR2/LOC2 → GPS
Timer (start at FAF for timed approaches) and Minimums (BARO DA/MDA)
Appears at the MAP: press to resume sequencing into the missed approach
Tune the cyan standby frequency; push small knob to switch NAV1/NAV2
Swap standby to active
NAV audio volume; ID toggles Morse identifier audio
Heading bug; push = sync to current heading
Course for VOR/LOC; push = center the CDI
Selected altitude (where the autopilot levels); push = sync to current altitude
Engage/disengage the autopilot (turns on the flight director)
Flight director command bars on/off
Follow the heading bug
Follow the CDI source (GPS, VOR, LOC) enroute
Approach: arms LOC+GS, VAPP or GPS+GP depending on the approach
Hold current altitude
Vertical speed; set the rate with the NOSE UP/DN wheel
Flight level change: climb/descend at a set airspeed
Vertical path to flight-plan altitudes (not for the final approach segment)
Adjust the VS rate, FLC speed or pitch reference
Autopilot disconnect (on the yoke)
Power lever button: go-around pitch on the flight director, sequences the missed approach
